top_signals.title: Japan Poised to Ramp Up LNG Buying as Power Prices Surge
top_signals.summary: Japanese utilities may raise spot LNG cargo buying as surging electricity prices in recent days have made gas-fired power generation profitable for the first time since the Iran war began.  Japan’s physical spark spread, the difference between the price received by a power-generating facility for electricity produced, has turned positive on a seven-day average for the first time since the Middle East conflict began, data compiled by Bloomberg showed on Tuesday. A positive spark spread means utilities will earn more from selling electricity…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ukraine confirms it sank Russian corvette in Libyan port
top_signals.summary: Ukraine was behind the explosive sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi over the weekend, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, and the country’s military released accompanying videos.
